question: From Tables 3 and 7, how much lighter is the multilayer crystal with both layers at 400 °C than the single-layer standard group 2 crystal at 400 °C?
rendered:
According to Table 3, the mean mass of the single-layer standard group 2 crystal at 400 °C is 1.118 g.

According to Table 7, the mean mass of the multilayer crystal with both layers at 400 °C is 2.947 g.

The multilayer crystal is 2.947 - 1.118 = 1.829 g heavier than the single-layer standard group 2 crystal at 400 °C.
